summary.text: Angelia Orr is a Republican state representative from Hill County who has represented Texas House District 13 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a farmer, rancher and business owner who previously served on the Itasca school board and as district director for a state representative.

paragraphs.text: Angelia Orr lives in Hill County, Texas, and earned a bachelor's degree in environmental design and architecture from Texas A&M University in 1992.
Her career experience includes working as a farmer, rancher, business owner, and district director for State Representative Cody Harris (R).
She was elected to the Itasca school board in 2007 and also to the position of district clerk.
Orr succeeded Ben Leman in representing District 13 and assumed office on January 10, 2023.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the County Affairs, House Administration and Appropriations committees.
She defeated Albert Hunter in the November 5, 2024 general election and advanced from the March 3, 2026 Republican primary; Hunter is again listed in the 2026 general election.
